title: fisk-ai A2A v1 elicit request
description: A question a running task puts to the caller that submitted it, sent on the task's reply set. The header's request names the task and question_id names the question within it.

question_id.description: Correlates the reply. Unique within the task.

tool_use_id.description: The tool call this question is about, which is what an answer given after the run has ended names: a resume asks the question again under a new question_id, so the call is what both ends agree on. Absent from an agent that takes no answer once its run has ended.

kind.description: Which of the four questions this is: whether a confirmation-gated command may run, a yes/no question, a choice among options, or a free text value.

question.description: The text to put to the operator, for confirm, select and input. Model-supplied and sanitized before sending; sanitize again for your own surface.

command.description: The command path an approve question is about, e.g. stream rm.

display.description: The full command line an approve question shows, already sanitized.

tag.description: The tag that gated the command, e.g. ai:confirm, so the operator sees why they are being asked.

options.description: The choices a select question offers, in the order to show them. The reply answers with a position in this list.

default.description: The value an input question pre-fills for the operator to accept or edit.

wait_ms.description: How long this question is held open before the agent gives up on it, in milliseconds. A caller with a person in front of the question sends an elicit reply of waiting every third of it to restart it. Absent is an agent that predates this and takes no such replies, as is a 400 in answer to one; answer inside the window instead.
